kit.doc: /** 🧰️ The shared shard client test kit: the destructured dependencies, the fake shard worker, the client harness and the resident, lifecycle and output fixtures of the settlement tests. */

kit.fdoc: Creates the shared shard client test kit of one registration from the injected dependencies.
